description: This script facilitates incremental documentation generation for plugins by processing changed files, validating JSON changes, and invoking other scripts for documentation creation from headers and JSON outputs. It is used within an automated documentation workflow.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts plugin name from a given file path based on known directory structures.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Checks whether JSON changes in 'apis/' correspond to existing output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/'.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Determines which plugins need documentation updates based on changed files, categorizing by file types.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates documentation for a specific plugin by invoking other scripts based on changed file types.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs post-processing on generated markdown files, removing specific markup for cleanliness.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Runs an external script to update the documentation sidebar.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main orchestrator that coordinates validation, plugin processing, documentation generation, post-processing, and sidebar update.
